description: This file contains rendering logic for an interactive scene in a drawing application, including functions for highlighting, selection borders, transform handles, and rendering various element types on a canvas.

methods.name: renderElbowArrowMidPointHighlight
methods.description: Highlights the midpoint of an elbow arrow segment during editing.

methods.name: renderLinearElementPointHighlight
methods.description: Highlights a specific point on a linear element during editing.

methods.name: highlightPoint
methods.description: Draws a highlight circle at a given point.

methods.name: renderSingleLinearPoint
methods.description: Renders a handle for a linear element point.

methods.name: renderBindingHighlightForBindableElement_simple
methods.description: Renders a simple binding highlight for a bindable element.

methods.name: renderBindingHighlightForBindableElement_complex
methods.description: Renders a complex binding highlight for a bindable element with animation effects.

methods.name: renderBindingHighlightForBindableElement
methods.description: Chooses between simple and complex binding highlight rendering based on feature flag.

methods.name: renderSelectionBorder
methods.description: Draws a border around selected elements with optional dashed style.

methods.name: renderElementsBoxHighlight
methods.description: Highlights a group or multiple elements with a bounding box.

methods.name: renderLinearPointHandles
methods.description: Renders handles for points on linear elements, including midpoints and segment points.

methods.name: renderTransformHandles
methods.description: Renders resize and rotate handles around selected elements.

methods.name: renderCropHandles
methods.description: Renders handles for cropping image elements.

methods.name: renderTextBox
methods.description: Renders a bounding box around a text element.

methods.name: _renderInteractiveScene
methods.description: Main function that renders the entire interactive scene including elements, selections, handles, highlights, and UI overlays.

methods.name: renderInteractiveScene
methods.description: Wrapper that calls _renderInteractiveScene and executes a callback with its result.
